notes.title: June 10 Update: English Support & Typo Fixes
notes.notes:
Added English language option in Settings. You can now switch between Japanese and English.
Fixed various typos throughout the game text.

notes.title: The update for “Goblin Gnome Horn” has been released:
notes.notes:
・Fixed a bug where the boss would freeze when performing its jump attack
・Fixed a bug that allowed the player to remain controllable briefly even after health reached zero
・Fixed a bug where the clear time was not being counted correctly
・Fixed a bug that made the UI difficult to see when playing on Mac
Thank you for your continued support of “Goblin Gnome Horn.”
